text_block_list.text:
There were some documents that required a 
signature, so when I went to have Super 
Creek write her name—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Could you look away for 
just a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the truth is... my skin is 
breaking out right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I've been asked to do a lot of dishwashing 
and cleaning chores lately...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Partly due to being so busy, I ended up 
neglecting proper care..."
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Does it hurt—
Are you okay? How's the pain—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez, that's why I told you not to look! 
Trainer, no peeking!

When I tried to check on her, she got mad 
at me. She pushed my face away and stared 
out the window for a while...
